claims.assertion: Mari reports 89-year-old Toleka left Earth orbit for Temmer because aging systems required constant maintenance.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka can cover 440 light-years in seven hours at full power; crew travel time includes ship-internal frequency-transition time.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka will stop at Cyndriel, then face a 375-light-year leg to Temmer; Vigilant Eagle escorts her.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka’s future in Temmer—repair, storage, memorial, or dismantling—was undecided.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari reports Sadicleya replaced Toleka as flagship, with Alcyone, Asterope, Hyades, and Saska 1 remaining near Earth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

review_flags: Figures and ship status are Mari’s account as of August 2024
